build_post_http_request: build a python function to send HTTP POST requests to a vLLM API server with configurable prompt, n, and stream options
create_get_streaming_response: create a python function to parse streaming JSON responses from a vLLM API server and yield text outputs
test_get_response: test a python function that parses non-streaming JSON responses from a vLLM API server and returns text outputs
refactor_parse_args: refactor a python argparse CLI module to support configurable host, port, n, prompt, and stream arguments
run_main: run the vLLM API client main function to send a prompt to a vLLM server and print beam candidate outputs
